criteria.requirement: Add babel.lists.format_list_to_parts(lst, style="standard", locale=None). Return ordered dictionaries with type element/literal, exact value, and original input index or None. Concatenation must equal format_list for all supported CLDR styles, fallback styles and locales, including repeated/empty strings, braces and Unicode. Do not locate elements by searching formatted text or use collision-prone sentinels. Preserve input and format_list.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
